verdict.rationale: Vue exposes its core functionality entirely through a well-documented JS API (vue-docs-3) and even provides an llms.txt for LLM-consumable docs (vue-probe-1), but there's no OpenAPI/swagger spec or agent-oriented programmatic interface (vue-probe-2 shows 404s across all candidate spec URLs), so 'driving' it as an external service via API doesn't apply in the SaaS sense.
